attempts.summary: Configured PostgreSQL 16 streaming replication on node1 (primary, writable), node2 and node3 (standbys), all AlmaLinux 9.6. Replication traffic is TLS-only over a self-signed cluster CA created for this task; the primary only accepts replication connections presenting a client certificate issued by that CA (hostssl + cert auth, verify-full). Falsification tests confirmed non-SSL, SSL-without-client-cert, and certs from an untrusted CA are all rejected, while CA-signed certs succeed. Completed the mandatory restart protocol on all three nodes (standbys first, primary last), each showing a changed boot_id and full recovery of the PostgreSQL service, replication streaming/slots, TLS client-cert identity, and replicated data.
